svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(102, 102, 102), rgb(149, 149, 149)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(204, 204, 204), rgb(62, 62, 62)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));
